content: Of all the active user accounts, $1,363,499$ users made at least one change to their profile attributes over all the snapshots. Thus, over $3\%$ of all the active users engaged in some form of profile change activity over the 9 snapshots. Of these $1,363,499$ users, more than $95\%$ of the users made only 1 change to their profile, and around 275 users made more than 20 changes. On an average, each one of these $1,363,499$ users made about 2 changes to their profiles with a standard deviation of $1.42$.
